name: Patagonian foxes
description: The two Patagonian foxes - the culpeo (Lycalopex culpaeus) and the grey or chilla fox (L. griseus) - among the rabbit's chief predators and the region's signature mesopredators. Functional group pooling 2 source nodes (2 native, 0 exotic, 0 mixed-origin); between them they take rodents, hare, rabbit, birds, insects and even fruit, and the puma kills both.
